consumer_marketplace_components.name: MarketplaceHeader
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Dynamic header with City selector (Hyderabad neighborhoods: Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Hitec City, etc.), live quick search bar with instant autocomplete, category pills with animated active indicator, Shortlist counter badge, and Vendor/Admin mode switcher.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: DynamicCategoryBar
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Zepto-inspired dynamic category navigation with instant color re-theming (Venues, Photography, Catering, Decoration, Entertainment, Makeup/Beauty, Corporate). On click, smoothly applies category color aura to the page.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: HeroBannerCarousel
consumer_marketplace_components.description: High-impact auto-sliding hero with location-specific promos ('Book Top Banjara Hills Venues with 0% advance lock', 'Royal Sangeet Artists in Hyderabad'). Glassmorphism badge, CTA, and micro-animations.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: VendorListingCard
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Rich listing card with photo carousel, verified tick, distance in km (e.g. '2.4 km away in Jubilee Hills'), starting price per plate/day, Star rating + review count, 'Quick Enquire', 'Favorite', and 'Compare' toggle.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: VendorProfileModalOrPage
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Airbnb-style comprehensive view: cover gallery with high-res thumbnails, Verified Badge & KYC status, package selector (Silver/Gold/Platinum), amenities list, Hyderabadi landmark map badge, past real weddings, customer reviews with photo proof, and instant Enquiry/Book drawer.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: VendorComparisonDrawer
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Side-by-side comparison matrix for up to 3 shortlisted vendors (Pricing, Capacity, Guest Rating, Amenities, Cancellation Policy, Direct Contact).

consumer_marketplace_components.name: EventPlannerMyEvent
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Consumer 'My Event' command center: Budget Tracker (visual progress bar, spent vs allocated), Interactive Checklist (Pre-wedding, Sangeet, Muhurtham, Reception tasks), and Day-of Timeline schedule.

consumer_marketplace_components.name: EnquiryBookingFlowModal
consumer_marketplace_components.description: Step-by-step frictionless booking & quote request modal: Select Event Date, Guest Count, Package Preference, Special Notes, with simulated instant quote estimate.

vendor_dashboard_components.name: VendorDashboardShell
vendor_dashboard_components.description: SaaS command center for verified vendors: Key stats (Total Leads, Active Quotes, Confirmed Bookings, Revenue in ₹ Lakhs, Rating 4.9/5), Lead pipeline kanban/table, Quote sender tool, Availability Calendar (block dates), and Service & Package manager.

admin_dashboard_components.name: AdminDashboardShell
admin_dashboard_components.description: Super Admin operations hub: Vendor KYC Verification queue (Approve/Reject with doc review), Dynamic Category theme manager, Banner carousel organizer, Commission & Revenue breakdown, and City expansion toggle.

guidelines: Use crisp scale transforms (whileHover: { scale: 1.02 }, whileTap: { scale: 0.98 }) for buttons and listing cards.
Category theme change should apply a 300ms CSS variable / Tailwind transition without jarring layout reflows.
Card image hovers: gentle zoom (scale-105 transition-transform duration-500).
Skeleton loaders during search or filter actions: pulsing subtle purple-slate skeletons.
Favor lightweight CSS keyframe animations for category glow pulses; keep mobile 60fps fluid.

accessibility_and_testing_rules.data_test_id_convention: MUST include data-testid on every interactive element using kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='category-chip-venues', data-testid='vendor-card-taj-banquet', data-testid='enquire-now-button', data-testid='location-selector-dropdown', data-testid='compare-checkbox-vendor-1').
accessibility_and_testing_rules.contrast_standards: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large display titles). White text over gradients must have backdrop-blur and semi-transparent dark tint scrim (e.g. bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent).
accessibility_and_testing_rules.no_transparent_surfaces: All dropdowns, popovers, mobile sheets, and dialogs must have explicit opaque or glass backgrounds (bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 or bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 with backdrop-blur-xl).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Component Reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable; customize with Tailwind classes.

Ensure all mock vendors use realistic Hyderabad areas (Banjara Hills Road No 10, Jubilee Hills, Financial District, Hitec City, Secunderabad Club Road) with authentic pricing in Indian Rupees (₹) and Indian numbering format (e.g., ₹1,800/plate, ₹1,20,000/day, ₹4,50,000 package).
implementation_checklist_for_main_agent: 1. Setup top Navigation with location detector ('Hyderabad - Jubilee Hills' default), Search bar, dynamic Category switcher, Shortlist badge, and role switcher tab (Customer / Vendor Portal / Super Admin).

2. Implement Category Color Theme Context that updates CSS variables / theme class so active category (Venues, Photography, Catering, Decor, etc.) bathes the hero search, badge borders, and accents in corresponding vibrant hue.
3. Build responsive Hero Banner with dynamic slide carousel showcasing real Indian wedding setups, discount badges, and instant booking hooks.
4. Construct high-density vendor listing grid with interactive filters (Budget, Guest Capacity, Rating 4.5+, Veg/Non-Veg, Distance) and comparison tray.
5. Develop Airbnb-style detailed Vendor Profile Modal/Page with interactive package calculator and instant enquiry drawer.
6. Include the 'My Event' Planner feature with interactive budget tracker, milestone checklist, and day schedule.
7. Include simulated Vendor SaaS workspace (leads, quote generation, availability calendar) and Super Admin control panel (KYC approvals, category manager).
8. Ensure every button, input, tab, card, and modal has unambiguous data-testid attributes.
